threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground'—real locals know that’s where the good coffee shops are.
Caught a night bus last weekend—two guys argued over who could name the most obscure south London pubs. Turns out, one was a former bouncer from The Blue Anchor.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh döner mingling with the sound of a street musician playing an accordion at Hermannplatz—classic Neukölln moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a spontaneous techno party under an old railway bridge on a Tuesday night. Just bring your own drinks!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they still complain about BART even when the colors are fading. It's like the echo of frustration hangs in the air.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the bus stop with a saxophone while waiting for the 5. Only in SF do you get a live concert while you’re late to work.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think our quiet squares are just for sipping coffee; locals know they’re for late-night impromptu concerts under the stars.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they still hold onto their map, squinting at street names instead of using Google Maps.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it ‘the Overground’ instead of ‘the East London Line’ – it’s a classic rookie mistake.
Caught a guy on the 59 last night singing along to his headphones, totally oblivious to the bemused crowd. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a neighbor feeding pigeons while another was painting a mural of a cat on their garage door—it felt like the heart of Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous karaoke party at 2 AM in an open courtyard. And it’s not even that unusual.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a true local when they still call Valencia 'the street with the good burritos' instead of 'Valencia Street.' It’s a vibe.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Today, I watched a guy with a guitar serenade a dog on the 19-Polk. The pup seemed to love it more than half the passengers.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume every Plaça is for lounging, but the locals know they’re just as likely to be host to a protest or spontaneous concert.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their reluctance to embrace the 11am coffee break; the locals already have their second espresso by then.
